svg.text: Grey annotations are not drawn by the app. Scope: the kits, gaits, flock, dead pose, rider, icons, area tool + form. Context (HUD, picker layout, Details frame) is unchanged.
3-D map - the animal kits, side elevation, drawn from the kit's own metres (a 1 m scale bar under each)
coat: seeded per animal from a species palette (the TKB colour wins) - the same animal on every host; belly / wool = a lighter shade of the coat; horn, comb, beak = fixed bone / red / amber.
Gaits - one horse at rising speed: each LEG has its own phase of the cycle (offsets = the C# table; amplitude grows)
jump: fore legs fold forward and up, hind ones trail (height above ground)
A dead animal LIES - never a burning wreck
rolled onto its side over 0.6 s of sim time,
legs stiff, the coat as in life: no black wreck,
no flames, no smoke (Burns() excludes animals)
a hit flock drops birds (Count falls),
The flock - ONE entity (Count, Seed, Mode) drawn as N birds; each bird a closed-form offset of (seed, index, sim time)
each bird beats its own wings
seek, replay jump and a late-joining node draw the SAME birds (nothing is integrated); when Count falls the highest indices go, the rest stay put.
The rider - in the saddle: legs round the barrel, hands on the reins; he FIRES while riding (rifle shouldered)
riding: reins in hand, rifle slung
firing from the saddle (the horse need not stop)
seat 0 (rider, a FIRING seat) · seat 1 (a second rider) behind him · the saddle is the horse's back, z 1.49
2-D map icons, the picker glyphs and the animal-area tool + its form (the drawing, the form fields)
picker glyphs (assets/icons/_cattle ...) in the 3-D look; the 2-D map draws the
species as a top-down body outline (a cow = a long oval + head, a bird = a cross)
Animal area (closed polyline), populated at run start
the one area tool: click points, close by double-click / the first point
never leave (default on for pigs and goats)
